adaptations.superuser: tests run as BicDB's bootstrap superuser `bicdb` (PostgreSQL reference: `postgres`).
adaptations.client_side_copy: single-line server-side `COPY ... FROM/TO :'var'` statements (fixture loads in test_setup and elsewhere) are sent as psql `\copy` with the variable resolved, because BicDB's COPY reads only STDIN / writes only STDOUT; the echoed line in the result file is restored to the original statement, so expected output is compared unchanged. Server-side COPY file I/O itself is reported as its own work-queue cluster.
